explanation: It is named after the Witwatersrand, the ridge on which Johannesburg grew after gold was found there in 1886. The rand replaced the South African pound.

claims.text: South Africa introduced the rand as its currency in 1961.
Kenya, Nigeria and Ghana did not introduce the rand; their currencies are the shilling, the naira and the cedi.
The rand is named after the Witwatersrand.
Gold was discovered on the Witwatersrand in 1886, and Johannesburg grew up on the ridge.
The rand replaced the South African pound.
